blocks.text: React Suspense
React Suspense lets you display an alternative HTML while waiting for code or data to load.
The alternative HTML can be a component, text, or any valid content.
What is Suspense?
Suspense is a React feature that lets your components display an alternative HTML while waiting for code or data to load.

Using Suspense

If a component takes time to load, you can use a Suspense component,
and it will display the fallback content while the component is loading.

Another common use of the Suspense component is when importing components with lazy loading:

In the example above we had to fake a delay of two seconds to see the loading message. A task like displaying three fruits from an array
  would be too fast to see the loading message at all.

But with lazy loading, we can import a component dynamically, and it will display a loading message while it is loading,
  even if the task is very fast.
